BACHELOR.note: Freshman (신입). TOPIK score valid as of online application deadline; trial-test scores not accepted.
Level 4 of the regular course at a Korean-language institute of a university certified under 교육국제화역량 인증제 (IEQAS).
세종학당 intermediate course or above; only certificates issued by an offline local King Sejong Institute; online certificates not accepted.
법무부 사회통합프로그램: 사전평가 61점 이상 or completion of stage 3 or above.
NIIED 재외동포 국내교육과정 한국이해과정 intermediate/advanced completion.
Required before graduation under school regulations. Separately, admits without TOPIK 4 or KLCP level 4 are limited to 14 credits per semester until met.

TRANSFER.note: Level 5 of the regular course at a Korean-language institute of an IEQAS-certified university.
세종학당 intermediate 2 or above; offline local institute certificates only.
사회통합프로그램: 사전평가 81점 이상 or completion of stage 4 or above.
Applies to all undergraduate international students.
